text:
I stopped in with my friend the other day and I'm completely in love with this gym.  It's clean, well laid out, and has most of what you would need when it comes to machines and free weights.  The space is very new and all their machines are great quality.  

They do not have the traditional gym locker/change rooms and instead have private change rooms and bathrooms complete with shower.  You get the whole room to yourself and it seems very clean and efficient! Their lockers are located out in the main area and they come with a complimentary key for each locker! No charge to use one and it's secure! 

There is a group exercise room but it's a bit smaller.  From the way the lockers are set up and the change rooms are private, I don't think they get too crowded.  I love this gym so much and if I weren't in a contract I would jump on it and join anytime!!!

I came to this gym on a week day. I have to say that it is a nice place, well illuminated, the layout is perfect, washrooms and change-rooms are in great conditions, in the washrooms they have showers as well. Also some products for customers to use.
I took a beginners kickboxing class. I didn't know what to expect but it was perfect, the class included a warm out, the workout and a cool down. Our trainer was awesome, he did all the class with us, same speed and without taking breaks while we worked out. 
Even when is really close to Whyte Ave I dint have problems finding a parking spot. 
The gym is located in a small bussiness area so you can do some groceries or stop by for a tea after your work out.
I would like to come back and try another class soon.

BEWARE of this place. Id give negative stars if I could. Started up at this gym a year ago for a 1 year annual membership. Thought the 41.99 would be worth the 24/7 access. The facilities were typically clean, just packed at all times due to the lack of space. After pushing through a year of having only 3 treadmills, 1 bench press and minimal other equipment I thought the time had come to look around for another gym. As my membership expired I was on that annual date, I was told from the local gym facilitator "not to worry, you just won't have access anymore. " Surprise surprise that supposedly was "miscommuincated" as I was then told the next day I needed a written letter to stop my auto-renewal. I provided the written letter via email, and AF decided to say they didn't receive it in time. I then was served a late charge for not giving my next months payment and an additional charge to cancel. 

Do what you want, I'm just saying beware of the poor service, lack of communication from "head office" that has no ways of contact. Who also take weeks to return your email, and reply with very vague answers, which leave you guessing and feeling like you're at fault. 

Scary thing is I didn't want to put a stop the unfair, unnecessary payments and have them come after me for $80+ 

$@*^%--ing scammers

Terrible gym atmosphere. Terrible customer service. Impossible to end membership even after contract has ended. 

The employees are cold and don't even respond when you say hello nor are they friendly or helpful when you ask for help.

To add to the unwelcoming environment, I also had a terible experience when trying to end my month to month membership (the year contract I signed automatically put me on a month to month when the contract was up). 
In March 2019 I requested by email to end my membership and was told to do so I was required to call and speak over the phone. I was then told over the phone that I needed to come in in person to end the membership. I was unable to come in person as I was away traveling and would be gone for some months. 

When I returned to Edmonton in September 2019 I re-attempted to end the membership in person and guess what they told me...to end the membership I needed to do so by email.. which was something I did in the first place.. in March. 

And to top it off, of course they won't end the membership right away it can only be done 30 days after the request, meaning I had to pay for both September and October. So finally after 8 months of an UN-USED membership I was finally free. 

Not only did the service and employees make coming to the gym uncomfortable it also cost me over 400$ of an un used membership due to miss information given to me by various employees.

Anytime fitness has closed due to COVID19 but we have an app where our trainer sends us messages and home workouts every day. Miss going late at night when it's basically empty and you have the place to yourself. They're still withdrawing payments to pay their bills but they'll be adding the missed time into the end of our contracts.

Be careful with this gym, they will and I mean WILL take monthly payments out of a frozen account, they dont down seem to overly care if there clients can even go to the gym or not. VERY RARE WILL THEY REFUND YOU FOR THERE FUCK UP.

0.1 / 5 stars

I came to this gym for a kickboxing class and I loved it!
The instructor took us step by step explaining each of the moves before adding more steps.
It was a very complete workout including punches, kicks and everything. We also did abs and planks at the end to help us strengthen our core.
It was in general an excellent class. 
The only downside is that the room was a little small (probably they didn't expect 20 people at this class) and there was no fan or air conditioning. It wanted to leave the room as it felt suffocated in there.
This place is 24-hours and located super close to Whyte Avenue. They have their own parking as it is in a small shopping mall. They also have showers, so you can go to Whyte Ave and enjoy a cup of coffee or a beer after the workout :)
